definitions.explanation: The practice of making oneself or others more attractive through various treatments and procedures.
The quality of having an attractive appearance or figure.

examples.japanese: {美容|びよう}{院|いん}で{髪|かみ}を{切|き}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had my hair cut at the beauty salon.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{美容|びよう}に{気|き}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: She pays attention to her appearance/beauty care.

examples.japanese: {美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい}を{受|う}ける{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of people getting cosmetic surgery is increasing.

examples.japanese: {美容|びよう}にいい{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I eat foods that are good for beauty.

examples.japanese: {美容|びよう}と{健康|けんこう}のために{運動|うんどう}している。
examples.english: I exercise for beauty and health.

examples.japanese: この{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{美容|びよう}に{効果|こうか}があると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This cosmetic is said to be effective for beauty.

notes:
{美容|びよう} relates to beauty and cosmetic care, often appearing in compound words related to the beauty industry.

Common compounds:
- {美容|びよう}{院|いん}/{美容|びよう}{室|しつ} (beauty salon, hair salon)
- {美容|びよう}{師|し} (beautician, hairdresser)
- {美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい} (cosmetic surgery)
- {美容|びよう}{液|えき} (beauty serum)

Contrast:
- {美容|びよう}{院|いん} (beauty salon - typically for women) vs {理容|りよう}{院|いん} (barbershop - typically for men)

Related terms:
- {健康|けんこう} (health) - often paired: {美容|びよう}と{健康|けんこう} (beauty and health)
